<MethodEndpoint

>

Create handles the HTTP request to create a new device.
It parses the request body into a CreateDeviceDTO, validates the input,
and calls the device service to create the device. On success, it returns
the created device with HTTP 201 status. On error, it returns an appropriate
HTTP error status and message.
